title: Deepest canyons
measure: Greatest depth in metres. There's no standard way to measure a canyon's depth: some figures run from the river to the canyon rim, others to the highest peak nearby, so every figure here is an estimate. All ten come from one source, WorldAtlas, to keep them as comparable as possible. Where it gives a range, the lower end is used.

entries.name: Yarlung Tsangpo
entries.note: Cuts around Namcha Barwa in the eastern Himalaya. Its average depth is about 2,270 m.
entries.source: WorldAtlas, 10 deepest canyons in the world

entries.name: Kali Gandaki
entries.note: Measured from the river to the highest peaks on either side, some say it's the deepest of all.
